variants.text: gflow drives Google Flow right from your terminal. Type a prompt, and Imagen and Veo generate it. Images, video, whole batches. No clicking through menus, no copy-paste. Your creative pipeline, fully scriptable.

Stop clicking through menus. With gflow, one command turns a prompt into finished images and video, generated, downloaded, and catalogued locally. The creative tool you love, now part of your workflow.
You live in the terminal, so should your AI video. gflow wraps Google Flow in a real CLI. Prompt in, MP4 out. Scriptable, repeatable, yours. pip install gflow-cli, and go.
